scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/scripts backend/tests frontend/src frontend/vite.config.js scripts
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix backend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix frontend --audit-level=high
